steps.body: Now mix the jumps. From 34, ten more then one more: 34 → 44 → 45. Do each jump in order, watching tens and ones.
steps.narration: Now mix the jumps. From thirty-four, ten more then one more: thirty-four to forty-four to forty-five. Do each jump in order, watching tens and ones.

widget.prompt: Start at 34. Make the first jump: 10 more.

commonLandings.feedback: 35 is one more. The first jump is ten more.
43 is nine more. A full ten-jump from 34 lands one step farther.

widget.missFeedback: A jump of ten from 34 lands on 44.
widget.successFeedback: The first jump lands on 44. Now the one-more jump starts here.

predict.prompt: Where will the first, ten-more jump from 34 land?
predict.reveal: The first jump lands on 44. That result becomes the starting number for the next step.

widget.prompt: Start at 44, the first landing. Make one hop forward.

commonLandings.feedback: That stayed on the first landing. Make the one-more hop.
That moved two. One more than 44 is one hop away.

explanationVariants: Add the ten first (44), then the one (45).

widget.prompt: Start at 34. Ten more, then one more. Where do you land?

commonErrors.feedback: That's only the ten jump. Add one more: 44 → 45.
That did one more then... it's ten AND one: 34 → 44 → 45.

steps.body: Jumps can go down too. From 58, ten less then one less: 58 → 48 → 47. Down for less, up for more.
steps.narration: Jumps can go down too. From fifty-eight, ten less then one less: fifty-eight to forty-eight to forty-seven. Down for less, up for more.

steps.body: Match each two-jump to its landing.

widget.prompt: Match each pair of jumps to where it lands.

pairErrors.feedback: 45 + 10 + 1 = 56. 54 is ten more then one LESS (45 → 55 → 54).
45 + 10 − 1 = 54. 56 is ten more then one MORE.

explanationVariants: Ten less to 48, one less to 47.

widget.prompt: Start at 58. Ten less, then one less. Where do you land?

commonErrors.feedback: That's only the ten jump. One less more: 48 → 47.
That did one less only. It's ten AND one less: 58 → 48 → 47.

explanationVariants: Ten more changes the tens digit; one more changes the ones digit. Each touches a different place.
The ten jump moves the tens; the one jump moves the ones.

widget.prompt: A ten jump changes which digit?

options.label: the ones digit
options.feedback: That's the ONE jump. A ten jump changes the tens digit.

options.label: the tens digit
options.feedback: Yes — ten more/less moves the tens; the ones stay.

options.label: both digits
options.feedback: A ten jump changes only the tens (unless it rolls a hundred). The ones stay.

hints: Ten lives in the tens place.

explanationVariants: Ten more to 82, one less to 81.

widget.prompt: Start at 72. Ten more, then one less. Where do you land?

commonErrors.feedback: That's only the ten jump. One less more: 82 → 81.
That added one instead of subtracting. Ten more (82), then one LESS: 81.

steps.body: Course complete — you jump like a pro!
takeaways: Ten jumps move the tens; one jumps move the ones.
Up for more, down for less.

concept.body: Slow down. From 20: ten more is 30, then one more is 31. One jump at a time: 20 → 30 → 31.
concept.narration: Slow down. From twenty: ten more is thirty, then one more is thirty-one. One jump at a time: twenty to thirty to thirty-one.

explanationVariants: Ten more to 30, one more to 31.

widget.prompt: Start at 20. Ten more, then one more. Where do you land?

commonErrors.feedback: That's only the ten jump. One more: 30 → 31.
That did one more only. It's ten AND one: 20 → 30 → 31.
